text: $BTC sellers capitulated again yesterday. Every burst of loss selling came right at a local bottom: early August, mid-August and mid-September. Profit taking has slowed since the September high. If the pattern holds, yesterday's selling just above $80k would mark the floor.

Buyers kept refilling the $BTC book today. The low timeframe view shows that the large bids that sat at $80k for the last week were filled and new large bids were placed, pushing price up systematically. Now we see the support level under $80k weakening again.
